# Getty Images
> Getty Images is a global licensing platform for royalty-free creative assets, editorial imagery, video, music, and AI-generated visuals.

Getty Images provides searchable collections for commercial and editorial use, along with licensing information, subscription plans, enterprise workflows, and contributor resources.

## Core Platform
- [Getty Images Home](https://www.gettyimages.com): Main entry point for searching and licensing photos, video, illustrations, and music.
- [Search](https://www.gettyimages.com/search/2/image): Search interface for discovering images across creative and editorial collections.
- [Sign In](https://www.gettyimages.com/sign-in): Account login for customers, contributors, and enterprise users.
- [Register](https://www.gettyimages.com/register): Account creation page for new Getty Images users.
- [Boards](https://www.gettyimages.com/boards): Saved boards for organizing, curating, and sharing selected assets.
- [Pricing](https://www.gettyimages.com/plans-and-pricing): Overview of subscription, pack, and enterprise licensing options.

## Creative Content
- [Creative Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/creative-images): Browse royalty-free and rights-managed creative imagery for commercial projects.
- [Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/creative-images/stock-photos): Commercial stock photography collection spanning business, lifestyle, travel, and more.
- [Illustrations](https://www.gettyimages.com/illustrations): Search vector and raster illustrations for design and marketing use.
- [Vectors](https://www.gettyimages.com/vectors): Vector artwork collection for scalable graphics and branded materials.
- [Creative Video](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos): Stock video footage for advertising, social, and digital storytelling.
- [Music](https://www.gettyimages.com/music): Production music licensing for video, advertising, and multimedia projects.

## Editorial Content
- [Editorial Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/editorial-images): News, sport, and entertainment photography for editorial publishing use.
- [News](https://www.gettyimages.com/editorial-images/news): Current events and breaking news imagery from global coverage.
- [Sport](https://www.gettyimages.com/editorial-images/sport): Sports photography covering leagues, tournaments, athletes, and live events.
- [Entertainment](https://www.gettyimages.com/editorial-images/entertainment): Celebrity, red carpet, film, television, and music event coverage.
- [Archive Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/archive): Historical and archival imagery from Getty Images collections.
- [Editorial Video](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos?assettype=film&family=editorial): Editorial footage covering news, sports, and entertainment events.

## Video and Motion
- [Video Home](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos): Browse stock and editorial video footage collections.
- [4K Video](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos/4k): High-resolution 4K footage for broadcast and digital production.
- [HD Video](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos/hd): HD stock footage for general production and online publishing.
- [Aerial Video](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos/aerial): Drone and aerial footage for landscapes, cities, and travel scenes.
- [Slow Motion Video](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos/slow-motion): Slow-motion clips for cinematic and promotional editing.
- [Time Lapse Video](https://www.gettyimages.com/videos/time-lapse): Time-lapse footage for environmental, urban, and creative storytelling.

## AI Tools
- [Generative AI by Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai): Commercially safer AI image generation trained for licensed creative workflows.
- [AI Generator](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai/generator): Prompt-based image generation tool for creating licensable visuals.
- [AI Image Editor](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai/image-editor): AI-assisted editing workflow for modifying and refining generated imagery.
- [AI Inpainting](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai/inpainting): Generative fill tool for replacing or extending parts of an image.
- [AI Outpainting](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai/outpainting): Expand image boundaries with AI-generated visual continuation.
- [AI Commercial Safety](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai): Overview of indemnification and licensing protections for AI content.

## Licensing and Plans
- [Plans and Pricing](https://www.gettyimages.com/plans-and-pricing): Compare subscriptions, packs, and enterprise access models.
- [Royalty-Free License](https://www.gettyimages.com/resources/creative-images/royalty-free): Explanation of royalty-free licensing for creative assets.
- [Rights-Managed License](https://www.gettyimages.com/resources/creative-images/rights-managed): Details on rights-managed licensing and usage restrictions.
- [Editorial Use](https://www.gettyimages.com/resources/editorial-photography): Guidance on editorial imagery and publishing limitations.
- [Music Licensing](https://www.gettyimages.com/music): Licensing options for production music and soundtrack use.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.gettyimages.com/enterprise): Enterprise workflows for teams, brand management, and large-scale licensing.

- [Help Center](https://www.gettyimages.com/help-center): Support hub for licensing, downloads, billing, and account questions.
- [FAQ](https://www.gettyimages.com/help-center/faq): Frequently asked questions about usage, purchasing, and platform features.
- [License Compliance](https://www.gettyimages.com/help-center/license-compliance): Information about proper asset use and compliance requirements.
- [Download Help](https://www.gettyimages.com/help-center/downloads): Guidance for downloading purchased or licensed assets.
- [Contact Us](https://www.gettyimages.com/contact-us): Customer support and contact options for sales and service inquiries.
- [Accessibility](https://www.gettyimages.com/company/accessibility-statement): Accessibility statement for Getty Images services and website.

## Contributors
- [Contributor by Getty Images](https://contributors.gettyimages.com): Contributor portal for photographers, videographers, and illustrators.
- [Apply to Contribute](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/apply): Application page for creators seeking to license content through Getty Images.
- [Contributor Sign In](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/sign-in): Login for existing Getty Images contributors.
- [Contributor Resources](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/resources): Guidance, policies, and best practices for contributors.
- [Submission Requirements](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/resources/submission-requirements): Technical and editorial standards for submitted content.
- [Contributor FAQ](https://contributors.gettyimages.com/resources/faq): Answers to common contributor questions about submissions and royalties.

## Popular Search Entry Points
- [Nature Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/nature): Search results for nature photography and outdoor imagery.
- [Business Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/business): Search results for business and workplace stock imagery.
- [Travel Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/travel): Search results for travel destinations, tourism, and adventure visuals.
- [Family Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/family): Search results for family lifestyle and relationship imagery.
- [Backgrounds](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/background): Search results for abstract, textured, and design background images.
- [Technology Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/technology): Search results for technology, devices, and innovation-themed visuals.
